name: Kyoukaisen no Hate ~Futatsu no Seibetsu, Futatsu no Seikaku~
original_name: 境界線の果て～ふたつの性別、ふたつの性格～
source:
One day, Shio visits a sick-room of his school because he gets injured. But he accidentally drinks a medicine and becomes a girl...

He decides to leave school for a while and comes back with a different name, Shiori...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一天，汐受伤后前往学校医务室，却意外喝下一种药物，变成了少女…

他决定暂时离开学校，后来以“诗织”这个不同的名字重新归来…

[摘自ErogeShop]
